dessin: A cropped excerpt of a printed topographic map seen from above, filling the ENTIRE image edge to edge: the pale paper color #FBFCF8 covers the whole image, no outer background color, no frame, no border, no outline around the image, no margin; the drawing is cut cleanly by the four image edges as if the map continued beyond them. Relief only: about eight smooth brown contour lines #B08A62 (thin, about 1.5 px) forming a gentle hill whose summit is slightly right of center, the lines roughly concentric and irregular, some running off the image edges; one of them, the fifth from the summit, is thicker and darker #8E6640 (an index contour). No water, no roads, no buildings. No text, no letters, no numbers, no contour labels, no symbols other than those described, nothing else.
